subdivision_of_building: Roof top above half of the ground floor venue
description: Removal of two underground tube carriages, installation of a pergola, glass balustrade, replacement access staircase and new access staircase, all in connection with use of existing rooftop shipping containers for the provision of daytime work spaces, evening food and drink (servery), and use of the rooftop terrace as amenity space including the installation of a pergola and replacement access staircase, all ancillary to the primary arts and cultural venue
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

No development shall take place until a detailed Construction Logistics Plan Statement (CLP) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, in consultation with Transport for London. This should be in line with TfL CLP guidance:  https://content.tfl.gov.uk/clp-guidance-clocs.pdfThe CLP shall set out how construction and deliveries will be carried out with regard to the affected highways and in order to minimise disruption to the surrounding road network.The development shall only be implemented in accordance with the details and measures approved as part of the Construction Logistics Plan Statement, which shall be maintained throughout the entire construction period.  REASON: To avoid hazard and obstruction being caused to users of the public highway and in the interest of public safety and amenity and to mitigate the negative impact on the surrounding highway network.

Full details, with samples or product images and specification, of the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the development, including glazing and doors, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing prior to the commencement of superstructure works. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the development is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.

Detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, prior to the installation of lighting. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved which shall be implemented in full prior to the first occupation/use of the development.a) Details of the lighting scheme, including colour and colour temperature, luminosity levels and direction of lighting.REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area.
